name: Subtalar Joint Osteoarthritis
definition: Degenerative arthritis of the subtalar joint, commonly post-traumatic after calcaneal fracture or associated with hindfoot deformity.

investigations.principle: Weight-bearing radiographs and CT define joint degeneration; MRI is selective.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Persistent severe disease may require subtalar fusion.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada/Gulpha Sandhigata phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Degenerative arthritis of the subtalar joint, commonly post-traumatic after calcaneal fracture or associated with hindfoot deformity.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
